description: Read the business's website: `document` (the v3 site document — settings, home, pages, and templates[page_id] → sections → blocks, with the ids every other site op needs), `theme` (what the live theme offers: every section and block type with its settings, the theme settings, and style presets), `resolved_settings` (the concrete theme settings the site renders with), `live_theme` (the custom theme code in use, with its file paths, or null for a system theme), `style_hooks` (stable [data-lk="…"] attributes custom_css can target on a system theme), `system_themes` (for set_system_theme) and `templates` (segment layouts for apply_template). Settings are listed compactly as "id:type(options)"; pass detail: "full" for labels and defaults. ALWAYS call this before changing the site.
name: get_site
title: Get site
